d:
The Gokuldham family’s exciting trip to Kutch continues! Amid freezing winter winds, shopping, and fun, Jethalal heads out with Daya to check out a prime plot of land. But will Jethalal manage to seal the deal, or will a new twist throw everything off track?
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
